subject: reasoning
question:
By interchanging the given two signs and numbers which of the following equation will be not correct?

+ and –, 3 and 5
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

According to the question, after interchanging the give**n ****two signs and numbers** :

 
• + and –
 
• 3 and 5

So,

__
 
• Option - (1) : 5 × 4 + 3 – 6 ÷ 2 = 10

3 × 4 - 5 + **6 ÷ 2**__ = 10

__**3 × 4**__ - 5 + 3 = 10

__**12 + 3**__ - 5 = 10

__**15 - 5**__ = 10

10 = 10 (LHS = RHS)

__
 
• Option - (2) : 7 × 4 ÷ 2 – 5 + 3 = 12

 

According to the question, after interchanging the given two signs and numbers :

 
• + and –
 
• 3 and 5

So,

7 × **4 ÷ 2**__ + 3 - 5 = 12

__**7 × 2**__ + 3 - 5 = 12

__**14 + 3**__ - 5 = 12

__**17 - 5**__ = 12

12 = 12 (LHS = RHS)

__
 
• Option - (3) : 5 × 4 – 3 + 4 ÷ 2 = 15

According to the question, after interchanging the given two signs and numbers :

 
• + and –
 
• 3 and 5

So,

3 × 4 + 5 - **4 ÷ 2**__ = 15

__**3 × 4**__ + 5 - 2 = 15

__**12 + 5**__ - 2 = 15

__**17 - 2**__ = 15

15 = 15 (LHS = RHS)

__
 
• Option - (4) : 5 – 3 + 8 × 4 ÷ 2 = 10

According to the question, after interchanging the given two signs and numbers :

 
• + and –
 
• 3 and 5

So,

3 + 5 - 8 × **4 ÷ 2**__ = 10

3 + 5 - __**8 × 2**__ = 10

__**3 + 5**__ - 16 = 10

__**8 - 16**__ = 10

-8 ≠ 10 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Hence, "Option - (4)" is the correct answer.
